ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity pixels (white) concentrated on the distal lobes versus 60% low-intensity pixels (black) in the central and peduncle regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric blobs occupy the outer 2/3 of both the left (x=0.05 to 0.40) and right (x=0.60 to 0.95) lobes, characterized by high-frequency dark mottling. The central 20% (x=0.41 to 0.59) is composed of solid low-intensity black pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 35 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular jaggedness along the continuous boundary; pixel-amplitude variations range from 5 to 20 pixels, with the most pronounced peaks located near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primarily convex curvature along the superior trailing edges, tapering to acute pointed lateral termini.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast objects (barnacle colonizations) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; smaller circular 'rosette' scars visible on the dark central pigmentation just below the notch vertex.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark, unaligned linear pixel streaks (rake marks) cutting through the white pigmentation on the distal portions of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal fluke tips; multiple irregular skin protrusions visible along the lower margin near the peduncle junction on the left side.
